in_marathi.name: Balaraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balaraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balaraj is a Sanskrit name, derived from two words: 'Bal' meaning strength and 'Raj' meaning rule or reign. The name signifies a powerful and authoritative leader, one who commands respect and admiration. In Hindu mythology, Balaraj is an epithet for Lord Vishnu, who is known for his immense power and the ability to maintain balance in the universe.
